name: explain-diff
description: Turn a diff, branch, or PR into a teaching artifact: HTML page or MyST Markdown document

interface.shortDescription: Explain a code change to a human reader, with diagrams and a comprehension quiz
interface.longDescription: Two skills that turn a diff, commit range, branch, or PR into a self-teaching artifact: deep and narrow background, the core intuition worked through toy data, a grouped walkthrough of the code, and five medium-difficulty multiple-choice questions with per-option feedback. Choose the output format by skill: a single self-contained HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript, or a MyST Markdown document using mermaid diagrams, admonitions, and dropdown answers.
defaultPrompt: Explain this PR as an HTML page with a quiz.
Write a MyST explanation of this branch's diff.
Explain this change for someone new to the codebase.
